title: feat(service-print): print a record's print page to a PDF in headless Chromium as the requesting user, and archive it on the record
body:
Fixes #22269

Clause-②: yes (widening)

Print page ③ of the B′ split: `@objectstack/service-print`, a render service with one engine (headless Chromium) that renders a record's print page under the requesting user's own principal and archives the PDF as a `sys_file` attached to the record. It builds on the landed `file-attachments` archive and binds to the principal-session mint of the seam card objectstack-ai/objectstack#23772.

**Binding state: this PR lands after #23772.** Until that member is on `main`, the service reads it through ONE package-local adapter (`packages/services/service-print/src/principal-session.ts`, `principalSessionMinterOf`), and `status()` reports `unavailable` naming `IAuthService.mintPrincipalSession`. Binding = replace that file's three local types with the contract's imports and type the read. No other file changes.

## What it adds

- **`PrintServicePlugin`** registers the in-process `print` service (`IPrintService`): `status()` and `printRecordToFile({ app, object, recordId, page, filename? }, context)`. Explicit composition; no route, no metadata key, no error code, no `requires` token.
- **One engine, two placements** (ruling of record on this card, OQ5 → B):
  - local: `OS_PRINT_CHROMIUM_PATH` / `chromiumPath`, `chromium.launch({ executablePath })` per render;
  - remote: `OS_PRINT_BROWSER_ENDPOINT` / `browserEndpoint`, a DevTools WebSocket endpoint, `chromium.connectOverCDP` per render;
  - both need `OS_PRINT_CONSOLE_URL` / `consoleUrl`, the console URL that browser reaches (`/_console` included). Both placements at once is refused as misconfigured.
  - `playwright-core` `1.63.0`, pinned exact on this package only (already in the lockfile).
- **Loud at `start()`**: the plugin probes the engine (launch or connect, read the version, close) and logs placement + Chromium version; absent, misconfigured or unreachable is one `warn` naming the setting; `status()` reports `ready | unconfigured | misconfigured | unavailable` with the reason. The remote endpoint is never logged beyond scheme and host (it may carry a token).
- **Refusals, in the ruled order, all before any mint or launch** (each pin asserts `code` + `status` and that mint, render and archive were never called):

  | # | condition | code / status |
  |:--|:--|:--|
  | 1 | not a human user acting for themselves (no context, system, agent/service/guest/system kind, an `authGate` hold) | `PERMISSION_DENIED` / 403 |
  | 2 | engine not `ready` | `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` / 503 |
  | 3 | unknown page | `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` / 404 |
  | 3 | page of another object, no `print`, or not the object's default record page | `VALIDATION_ERROR` / 400 |
  | 4 | record read AS THE CALLER returns nothing, or the read is refused 403 | `RECORD_NOT_FOUND` / 404 |
  | 5 | object without `enable: { files: true }` | `FILES_DISABLED` / 403 |

- **Then** mint (TTL 60 s, twice the 30 s render budget, under the contract's 120 s ceiling), render, `attachFile`, and **revoke in `finally`** (pinned after a failed render and after a refused archive).
- **The page binding**: the browser loads `CONSOLE/apps/APP/OBJECT/record/ID` with the minted cookie, waits for the print root (`data-print-page`) AND `window.__objectui.idle` for 3 consecutive polls, then `document.fonts.ready`, then `page.pdf({ preferCSSPageSize: true })` — the print keys are mapped to CSS once, by the console.
- **Showcase**: `showcase_invoice_document`, the invoice's default record page, declares `print`; `showcase_invoice` declares `enable: { files: true }`. Section headings and the page label are translated (en, zh-CN).
- Docs: `content/docs/ui/print-pages.mdx` (+ the ui landing row), the `packages.mdx` row, README, changeset.

## Measured (mechanism assumptions)

1. **The archive.** Built on `IFileAttachmentService.attachFile` as it is; no second archive entry. The caller-scoped refusal chain (record read with the caller's own context, `RECORD_NOT_FOUND`; the `FILES_DISABLED` pre-check) runs before any mint or launch. **Gap, measured on a real showcase boot** (the dogfood test's boot, contributor member): the archived rows carry `sys_file.owner_id = null`, `sys_attachment.uploaded_by = null`, `created_by = null`; the organization is stamped correctly. `attachFile` inserts under the system context, so the create hook returns before stamping `uploaded_by`, and the parent-EDIT gate does not run (the print service's own bar is READ, as M2 words it). Attributing the PDF to the requester needs an `IFileAttachmentService` change (spec), not made here.
2. **The page binding at `.objectui-sha` `f96f771140`.** The console renders a record ONLY on its bound page (the object's default record page, else the first record page); no URL renders a named, non-default page for a record (`RecordDetailView` calls `usePageAssignment(objectName)` without `pageName`). The print root marker exists: `PageRenderer` stamps `data-print-page` on a print page. **Measured end to end** with the console built at the pin, my driver, both placements, a normally signed-in session: the invoice print page renders on A4 with its details, line-items table, Chinese header and footer, and page number (`pdfinfo`: 1 page, 594.96 x 841.92 pts; fonts include `WenQuanYiZenHei`). Missing surface (objectui): a route that renders a named print page for a record.
3. **The mint (#23772) against the real console: does not boot.** With #23772's branch merged locally (never pushed), its minted session cookie keeps the console on "Opening your console…" for both a member and the admin, while a normal sign-in session for the same user renders the print page. Measured difference: the minted session's `updatedAt` advances on every `get-session` read (renewal write, `expiresAt` clamped back by `holdPrincipalSessionExpiry`), and the console re-reads `get-session` + the organization endpoints in a loop. Reported to the seat for #23772; this PR's driver is unaffected.
4. **The driver library**: `launch({ executablePath })` and `connectOverCDP(endpoint)` both work on Chromium 141; closing a CDP-connected browser leaves the remote browser running and its render context (and cookie) gone (pinned).
5. **The CJK pin**: text extraction cannot tell glyphs from boxes (`pdftotext` returns the Chinese text from a tofu render). The pin asserts every Chinese code point is a ToUnicode target of an embedded font. Ablation (Chromium narrowed to a Latin-only fontconfig, no code change), both placements red: `expected [ '发', '票', '客', '户', '名', '称', …(12) ] to deeply equal []`; restored green.

## Tests

- `@objectstack/service-print`: 59 tests — config (both placements, misconfiguration, redaction), service (every refusal, the order, mint/render/archive/revoke, no credential in a message), plugin `start()` loudness against a missing executable and a dead endpoint carrying a token, and the real-Chromium engine on both placements (render as the session, A4 from `@page`, the CJK pin, timeout → `TIMEOUT` / 504, remote cleanup). The Chromium file runs where `OS_TEST_PRINT_CHROMIUM_PATH` or `PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH/chromium` exists and says it was skipped otherwise.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/print-service-archive.dogfood.test.ts`: the plugin as composed on a real showcase boot (unconfigured status, 503, 403), and the service over the real kernel services: unknown page 404, non-print page 400, another user's invoice hidden by RLS 404 (with a caller/system control), and a successful archive as one committed `sys_file` + one `sys_attachment` on the invoice.

## Acceptance notes

- `packages/spec/liveness` still classifies `page.print` as planned ("not read YET"); the console and this service now read it. Spec-lane follow-up.
- Card ② print rendering, observed on the real PDF: the record details' "Show N empty fields" toggle reaches paper, and line-item column headings print field names rather than labels.
- The CJK pin measures the browser's host fonts; a local placement without a CJK font prints boxes. The docs page says so.

## Surface deviations (declared)

- `packages/spec/llms.txt`: the package count 71 → 72, forced by the new package (`check:llms-txt`), with a `@objectstack/spec` patch line in the changeset. No other `packages/spec` change.
- `turbo.json` and `scripts/cross-package-test-inputs.mjs`: the dogfood test's declared inputs gain `packages/services/service-print/src/**` (`check:cross-package-test-inputs`).
- `content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx`: census row 47d for the print service's system-context refusal (`check:system-context-census`).
